brief:
Israel barred Jean-Luc Mélenchon, a left-wing French presidential contender and leader of La France Insoumise, from entering the country, prompting the French government to issue a formal condemnation, Middle East Eye reported. France's foreign minister accused Prime Minister Netanyahu of making a "demagogic" move in announcing the entry ban.

The dispute centers on Mélenchon's political stance and rhetoric regarding Israel-Palestine affairs. Details of the specific grounds for the ban and the timing of its announcement were not disclosed in available reports.

title: France condemns Israel's ban on leftist politician Melenchon
